When applying this procedure, always consider the following:

• Measurements cannot be carried out on the airbag wiring.
  • Begin testing the system with the vehicle appliances still connected.
  • The fault must be "Present" or "Present Intermittently" and not "Intermittent". In the event of an Intermittent fault, the Procedure is not applicable. Check the line where the fault was reported carefully.
  • Not all the simulation sensors are available (e.g. side impact sensors).
The airbag fault warning light is controlled by a dedicated connection to the airbag control unit Instrument Panel Node.
The airbag wiring is a safety component. If faults occur in the wires or connectors, all the wiring must be replaced.

ELECTRICAL CONNECTION CHECK

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Turn the key to OFF.

Check the connector on the control unit is correctly connected

See E7030 AIRBAG

Move on to Step 2

The connector is not correctly connected

Reconnect the connector correctly

See E7030 AIRBAG

Clear the errors using the diagnostic tester and proceed to step 5

2

CHECK CLOCK SPRING CONTACT

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Disconnect the airbag wiring clock spring contact and connect a dummy resistance in its place.

Turn the key ON and activate communication with the diagnostic tester.

Check whether the fault in the driver's side front airbag has become intermittent

Move on to Step 3

The fault is still present

Turn the key to OFF.

Replace the facia wiring

Op. 5505C34 INTERGRATED INSTRUMENT UNDER FACIA FRONT AIR BAG WIRING - R R

Clear the errors using the diagnostic tester and proceed to step 5

3

CHECK DRIVER'S SIDE AIRBAG

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Turn the key to OFF.

Reconnect the clock spring contact to the airbag wiring.

Disconnect the charge from the steering wheel and connect the dummy resistance in its place.

Turn the key ON and activate communication.

Check whether the fault in the driver's side front airbag is still intermittent

Move on to Step 4

The fault has become Present

Turn the key to OFF.

Replace the clock spring

Op. 5580C12 CLOCK SPRING FOR AIR BAG MODULE ON STEERING WHEEL R R

Clear the errors using the diagnostic tester and proceed to step 5

4

REPLACE DRIVER'S SIDE AIRBAG

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Turn the key to OFF.

Replace the explosive charge on the steering wheel

Op. 5580C18 AIR BAG MODULE - R+R

Clear the errors using the diagnostic tester

Move on to Step 5
